cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings requires authentication and an active account.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings without authentication.
Send GET request to /api/meetings with the access token of an account that has since been deactivated.
exp: The anonymous request returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
The deactivated account's request returns HTTP 403 Forbidden.
pre: A member account signed in, kept the access token and was then deactivated.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings returns only meetings the caller may see, with paging metadata.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
page 1, pageSize 1, totalCount 1, totalPages 1.
items holds exactly the organizer's own Draft "Giao ban % tuần".
The other creator's meeting with the same title is not returned.
pre: thuky@trustcabinet.local owns a Draft titled "Giao ban % tuần".
Another creator owns a Draft with the same title that thuky is not related to.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings returns an empty page for no match or a page beyond the end.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings?status=Ended as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
Send GET request to /api/meetings?page=99 as the same user.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 200 OK.
items is empty; for the first request totalCount and totalPages are 0.
pre: thuky@trustcabinet.local has one Draft meeting and no Ended meeting.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings returns MSG32 with field errors for an invalid query.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG32", message "Tiêu chí danh sách cuộc họp không hợp lệ.".
errors has status and page.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings returns MSG38 with 500 when the database read fails.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG38", message "Không thể tải danh sách cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings returns MSG38 when the account check fails.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response with code "MSG38".
No meeting list is read.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
PostgreSQL becomes unreachable before the request (stop the container).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings creates a Draft and returns a Location that GET can read.

req.body: { "title": "Giao ban tuần", "plannedStartTime": "<tomorrow 09:00+07:00>", "plannedEndTime": "<tomorrow 10:00+07:00>", "mode": "InPerson", "location": "Phòng họp A", "sensitivity": "Internal", "description": "Kế hoạch tuần.", "participants": [{ "userId": "<id of chutoa>", "role": "Chair" }] }

steps: Send GET request to the URL in the Location header.
exp: HTTP 201 Created response with Location /api/meetings/<new id>.
Response JSON body: code "MSG29", message "Tạo cuộc họp thành công.", meeting.status "Draft", organizer is thuky.
GET on the Location returns HTTP 200 OK with the same meeting.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).
chutoa@trustcabinet.local is active.

cases.d: Verify creating a meeting needs participants (MSG277) and the roster cannot be changed through PUT.
steps: Send POST request to /api/meetings as thuky with a valid body but "participants": [].
Send it again with "participants": [{ "userId": "<id of chutoa>", "role": "Chair" }].
Send PUT request to /api/meetings/<new id> with the same body including participants.
exp: The first request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG277" and an error on participants; no meeting is created.
The second returns HTTP 201 Created; chair is chutoa, secretaries is empty.
The PUT returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG31" (participants are not editable here).
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings returns every validation error without saving.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG31", message "Thông tin cuộc họp không hợp lệ.".
errors has title and mode.
No meeting is created.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings requires the planned start and end time.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG31".
errors has plannedStartTime and plannedEndTime.
No meeting is created.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings rejects a start in the past and an end not after the start.
steps: Send POST request to /api/meetings as thuky with plannedStartTime 2 hours ago and plannedEndTime 1 hour ago.
Send POST request with plannedStartTime and plannedEndTime both <tomorrow 09:00+07:00>.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG31".
The first has errors.plannedStartTime "Thời gian bắt đầu phải sau thời điểm hiện tại.".
The second has an error on plannedEndTime.
No meeting is created.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings fills the meeting-level defaults.
exp: HTTP 201 Created response.
meeting.mode is "InPerson" and meeting.sensitivity is "Normal".
The blank onlineLink is stored as empty and the 90-minute schedule is returned as sent.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings rejects an online link longer than 1000 characters.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with an error on onlineLink.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify an approver sent by the client when creating a meeting is ignored.
exp: HTTP 201 Created response.
meeting.assignedApproverId is null; an approver is chosen only when submitting.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).

cases.d: Verify POST /api/meetings returns MSG35 with 500 when it cannot be saved.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG35", message "Không thể tạo cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.".
No meeting is created.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify anonymous callers and callers without MeetingCreator are stopped by the gate.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings/<any id> without authentication.
As quantri@trustcabinet.local (AdminUsers only), send POST /api/meetings with a valid body.
As the same user, send GET /api/meetings/approvers.
exp: The anonymous request returns HTTP 401 Unauthorized.
The POST and the approvers request return HTTP 403 Forbidden.
No meeting is created.
pre: quantri@trustcabinet.local has AdminUsers but not MeetingCreator.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/approvers lists the accounts that may approve.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
The body is a list of { id, fullName }, sorted by name, for example "An Nguyễn" then "Bình Trần".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).
Two active accounts "An Nguyễn" and "Bình Trần" have MeetingApprover.

cases.d: Verify the approver list never offers the caller, even when the caller can approve.
steps: Give thuky's role MeetingApprover as well.
Send GET request to /api/meetings/approvers as thuky, with and without another approver ("An Nguyễn") in the system.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response each time.
thuky never appears in the list.
"An Nguyễn" appears when that account exists; otherwise the list is empty.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator and MeetingApprover).

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/approvers returns MSG130 with 503 when the approvers cannot be read.
exp: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG130", message "Không thể tải danh sách người duyệt. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local (MeetingCreator).
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/approvers returns MSG130 when the caller's account check fails.
exp: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable response with code "MSG130".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
PostgreSQL becomes unreachable just before the request.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/approvers returns MSG130 when the database times out.
exp: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable response with code "MSG130".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
The database is slowed so the query times out (for example pause the PostgreSQL container).

cases.d: Verify cancelling the approver request stops the server work.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings/approvers as thuky while the database is paused.
Cancel the request in the client (close the Postman request) before it answers.
exp: The request is cancelled on the client.
The backend log shows the request was cancelled, not an error response.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
The PostgreSQL container is paused so the request waits.

cases.d: Verify a missing meeting and another creator's meeting return the same empty 404.
steps: As thuky, create a Draft and copy its id.
As a second creator, send GET request to /api/meetings/<that id>.
As the second creator, send GET request to /api/meetings/<random UUID>.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 404 Not Found with an empty body.
The two answers cannot be told apart.
pre: A second active account with MeetingCreator exists and is unrelated to thuky's meeting.

cases.d: Verify the assigned approver can read the meeting without MeetingCreator.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with the meeting.
pre: A meeting is WaitingApproval with chutoa@trustcabinet.local as its assigned approver.
chutoa is active and has no MeetingCreator.

cases.d: Verify an invited participant can read a Published meeting without MeetingCreator.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with the meeting.
pre: A Published meeting lists thanhvien@trustcabinet.local as an active participant.

cases.d: Verify related readers see a meeting only in the statuses they are allowed to.
steps: For each status (Draft, WaitingApproval, Rejected, Approved, Published, InProgress, Ended, Cancelled), prepare one meeting with chutoa as assigned approver and thanhvien as participant.
Send GET request to each meeting as chutoa and as thanhvien.
exp: The approver gets HTTP 200 OK from WaitingApproval onwards and 404 for a Draft.
The participant gets HTTP 200 OK only from Published onwards and 404 before.
A refused read is an empty 404, never 403.
pre: Meetings in every status exist for one organizer.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id} returns MSG37 with 500 when the database fails.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG37", message "Không thể tải thông tin cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped after sign-in.

cases.d: Verify GET /api/meetings/{id} keeps MSG37 when the account check fails.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response with code "MSG37".
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local.
PostgreSQL becomes unreachable just before the request.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{id} updates an owned Draft and ignores fields the client may not set.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG30", message "Cập nhật cuộc họp thành công.".
The meeting shows the new title, schedule, mode, location and sensitivity.
status stays Draft and the organizer stays thuky.
pre: Signed in as thuky@trustcabinet.local, who owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify a Rejected meeting can be edited without restarting approval.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with code "MSG30".
status stays Rejected.
The rejection with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu" is still in the history.
pre: thuky@trustcabinet.local owns a meeting that was rejected with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu".

cases.d: Verify a meeting that is WaitingApproval, Approved, InProgress or Ended cannot be edited (MSG33).
steps: For each meeting, send PUT request to /api/meetings/<id> as thuky with any body.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 409 Conflict.
Response JSON body: code "MSG33", message "Cuộc họp này không thể chỉnh sửa được nữa.".
No meeting changes.
pre: thuky owns one meeting in each of the statuses WaitingApproval, Approved, InProgress and Ended.

cases.d: Verify rescheduling a Published meeting returns MSG138 and notifies every invitee.

req.body: { ...same meeting..., "plannedStartTime": "<day after tomorrow 09:00+07:00>", "plannedEndTime": "<day after tomorrow 11:00+07:00>", "location": "Phòng họp B" }

steps: Open the notification bell of each invitee.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG138", message "Đã dời lịch cuộc họp. Người được mời sẽ nhận thông báo.".
Each invitee receives one reschedule notification.
The history records the reschedule.
pre: thuky owns a Published meeting with several invitees.

cases.d: Verify the organizer is not notified of their own reschedule.

req.body: { ...same meeting with the start moved one day later... }

exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Every other invitee is notified.
thuky, who is also on the roster, gets no notification.
pre: thuky owns a Published meeting and is also its Chair on the roster.

cases.d: Verify a Published meeting refuses changes outside the schedule.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG31".
Errors name the locked fields (title, sensitivity).
Nothing changes and no notification is sent.
pre: thuky owns a Published meeting.

cases.d: Verify rescheduling a Published meeting needs a start in the future.

req.body: { ...same meeting..., "plannedStartTime": "<30 minutes ago>", "plannedEndTime": "<30 minutes from now>" }

exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with an error on plannedStartTime.
Nothing changes.
pre: thuky owns a Published meeting.

cases.d: Verify saving a Published meeting without changes notifies nobody.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with code "MSG30".
No history entry and no notification are created.
pre: thuky owns a Published meeting.

cases.d: Verify an online Published meeting ignores a stored location the form cannot show.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with code "MSG30".
It is not treated as a reschedule: no history entry, no notification.
pre: thuky owns an Online Published meeting whose stored location is "Trực tuyến".

cases.d: Verify the meeting status is checked before invalid JSON is parsed.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/meetings/<id of a WaitingApproval meeting> as thuky with Content-Type: application/json and body {.
Repeat with body { "title": 42 }.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 409 Conflict with code "MSG33", not a JSON error.
pre: thuky owns a WaitingApproval meeting.

cases.d: Verify invalid JSON on an editable meeting returns MSG31.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/meetings/<id of a Draft> as thuky with Content-Type: application/json and body {.
Repeat for a Rejected meeting.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG31" ("Nội dung JSON không hợp lệ.").
pre: thuky owns a Draft and a Rejected meeting.

cases.d: Verify the status is checked before a missing or wrong Content-Type is refused.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/meetings/<id of a Draft> with Content-Type: text/plain and body {}.
Send PUT request to the same Draft with no Content-Type.
Send the same two requests to a WaitingApproval meeting.
exp: For the Draft both requests return HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type with code "MSG34" ("Content-Type phải là application/json.").
For the WaitingApproval meeting both return HTTP 409 Conflict with code "MSG33".
pre: thuky owns a Draft and a WaitingApproval meeting.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{id} refuses a JSON body larger than 64 KiB.
steps: Send PUT request to /api/meetings/<id of a Draft> with Content-Type: application/json and a body of 64 KiB + 1 byte.
Repeat with the same body sent in chunks (no Content-Length).
exp: Both requests are refused with HTTP 413 (request too large) or 400 Bad Request.
The meeting is not changed.
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{id} returns validation errors without changing the meeting.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG31" and an error on title.
The meeting keeps its previous values.
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify PUT /api/meetings/{id} returns MSG36 with 500 when it cannot be saved.
exp: HTTP 500 Internal Server Error response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG36", message "Không thể cập nhật cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: thuky owns a Draft.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped just before saving.

cases.d: Verify submission readiness does not need agenda items and changes nothing.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
ready is true and errors is empty.
The meeting stays Draft; nothing is saved.
pre: thuky owns a Draft with title, schedule and a Chair, but no agenda item.

cases.d: Verify readiness and submit on an Approved meeting return MSG41 without side effects.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings/<id of an Approved meeting>/submission-readiness as thuky.
Send POST request to /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with body { "action": "SubmitForApproval", "assignedApproverId": "<id of chutoa>" }.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 409 Conflict with code "MSG41" ("Cuộc họp không còn ở trạng thái Draft hoặc Rejected.").
The meeting stays Approved; no history or notification is added.
pre: thuky owns an Approved meeting.

cases.d: Verify readiness and history return MSG136 and MSG131 with 503 on a temporary read failure.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings/<id>/submission-readiness as thuky.
Send GET request to /api/meetings/<id>/history as thuky.
exp: Readiness returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG136" ("Không thể tải dữ liệu quy trình cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.").
History returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG131" ("Không thể kiểm tra tài khoản để thực hiện thao tác cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: thuky owns a Draft.
PostgreSQL is made unreachable just before each request.

cases.d: Verify SubmitForApproval moves a Draft to WaitingApproval and returns the history.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
status is "WaitingApproval" and assignedApproverId is chutoa.
The history now has a SubmitForApproval entry by thuky.
chutoa receives a notification.
pre: The demo Draft "SCRUM-19 — Luồng duyệt và công bố (demo)" exists, owned by thuky, with an agenda item.

cases.d: Verify submit returns MSG81 when the meeting is incomplete and MSG82 for an ineligible approver.
steps: Clear the title of thuky's Draft, then send POST /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with { "action": "SubmitForApproval", "assignedApproverId": "<id of chutoa>" }.
Restore the title "Giao ban tuần", remove MeetingApprover from chutoa's role, and send the same request.
exp: The first request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG81" ("Cuộc họp chưa đủ thông tin để gửi duyệt.").
The second returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG82" ("Người duyệt không hợp lệ hoặc không còn quyền duyệt cuộc họp.").
The meeting stays Draft.
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify an organizer cannot submit a meeting to themselves for approval (MSG82), whatever its sensitivity.
steps: For a Normal, Internal, Confidential and Secret Draft owned by thuky, send POST /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with { "action": "SubmitForApproval", "assignedApproverId": "<id of thuky>" }.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG82".
No status, history or notification is written.
pre: thuky has both MeetingCreator and MeetingApprover.
thuky owns four Drafts, one per sensitivity, each with a Chair and an agenda item.

cases.d: Verify a Rejected meeting can be resubmitted directly and keeps the earlier rejection.
steps: Send GET request to /api/meetings/<id>/submission-readiness as thuky.
Send POST request to /api/meetings/<id>/transitions with { "action": "SubmitForApproval", "assignedApproverId": "<id of the new approver>" }.
exp: Readiness returns HTTP 200 OK with ready true.
Submit returns HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG78"; status is WaitingApproval with the new approver.
The history has 2 entries; the earlier rejection with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu" is unchanged.
pre: thuky owns a Rejected meeting rejected by a former approver with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu".
A different active approver exists.

cases.d: Verify each transition returns its own success code.
steps: As the assigned approver (chutoa), send { "action": "Approve" } to a WaitingApproval meeting.
As chutoa, send { "action": "Reject", "reason": "Cần bổ sung số liệu" } to another WaitingApproval meeting.
As thuky, send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" } to a Rejected meeting.
As thuky, send { "action": "Publish" } to an Approved meeting with a Chair and a Secretary.
exp: Approve returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG43" ("Đã duyệt cuộc họp.").
Reject returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG44" ("Đã từ chối cuộc họp.").
ReturnToDraft returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG79" ("Đã đưa cuộc họp về bản nháp.").
Publish returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG45" ("Đã công bố cuộc họp.").
pre: Meetings in the needed statuses exist; chutoa has MeetingApprover, thuky has MeetingCreator.

cases.d: Verify a transition from the wrong status returns its own conflict code.
steps: As chutoa, send { "action": "Approve" } to a Rejected meeting.
As thuky, send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" } to a Draft.
As thuky, send { "action": "Publish" } to a Draft.
exp: Approve returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG132".
ReturnToDraft returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG133".
Publish returns HTTP 409 with code "MSG46".
No status changes.
pre: Meetings in the needed statuses exist.

cases.d: Verify a transition that cannot be saved returns its own code.
steps: Stop PostgreSQL just before each request.
As thuky, submit a complete Draft.
As chutoa, approve a WaitingApproval meeting.
As thuky, publish an Approved meeting with its roster.
exp: Submit returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG42".
Approve returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG88".
Publish returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG47".
The message of each is "Không thể chuyển trạng thái cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.".
pre: Meetings in the needed statuses exist.

cases.d: Verify a rejection reason longer than 1000 characters returns MSG84.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG84" ("Lý do từ chối không được vượt quá 1.000 ký tự.").
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
pre: chutoa is the assigned approver of a WaitingApproval meeting.

cases.d: Verify a Reject with a null reason is refused as a missing reason.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with a required-reason error.
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
pre: chutoa is the assigned approver of a WaitingApproval meeting.

cases.d: Verify transitions require JSON and return MSG34 otherwise.

req.as: Content-Type: text/plain; Authorization: Bearer <access token of thuky@trustcabinet.local>

exp: HTTP 415 Unsupported Media Type response with code "MSG34".
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify transitions refuse unknown fields, a null reason on ReturnToDraft and numeric actions.
steps: Send { "action": "ReturnToDraft", "status": "Draft" } to /api/meetings/<id>/transitions as thuky.
Send { "action": "ReturnToDraft", "reason": null }.
Send { "action": 4 }.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG80" ("Yêu cầu chuyển trạng thái không hợp lệ.").
The meeting does not change.
pre: thuky owns a WaitingApproval meeting with an assigned approver.

cases.d: Verify the action must be one exact name; nothing is published otherwise.
steps: Send POST /api/meetings/<id>/transitions as thuky with each action value: "4", "04", "+4", "SubmitForApproval,Publish", "Publish,Publish", " Publish ", "publish".
exp: Every request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG80".
The meeting stays Approved and has no new history.
pre: thuky owns an Approved meeting with a Chair and a Secretary.

cases.d: Verify ReturnToDraft from WaitingApproval checks the current approver and the organizer's rights.
steps: Case A: approver still eligible, organizer has MeetingCreator - send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" } as thuky.
Case B: approver lost MeetingApprover, organizer has MeetingCreator - send the same.
Case C: approver lost MeetingApprover, organizer lost MeetingCreator - send the same.
exp: Case A is refused (403 with code "MSG85"); the approver is still able to act.
Case B returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG79"; the meeting is Draft again.
Case C is refused; the meeting stays WaitingApproval.
pre: thuky owns a WaitingApproval meeting assigned to an approver.

cases.d: Verify the current approver cannot withdraw a blocked meeting on the organizer's behalf.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <access token of the blocked approver>

exp: HTTP 403 Forbidden response.
The meeting stays WaitingApproval with no new history or notification.
pre: The assigned approver lost MeetingApprover but has MeetingCreator.

cases.d: Verify an old self-assignment cannot be used to approve or reject (MSG85).
steps: As thuky, send { "action": "Approve" } to the meeting.
As thuky, send { "action": "Reject", "reason": "Lý do" }.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 403 Forbidden with code "MSG85" ("Bạn không có quyền thực hiện thao tác này.").
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
pre: A WaitingApproval meeting owned by thuky has thuky as its own approver (legacy data).
thuky has MeetingCreator and MeetingApprover.

cases.d: Verify the organizer can withdraw a meeting with a missing or self approver (MSG79).
steps: As thuky, send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" } to a WaitingApproval meeting assigned to thuky.
Repeat for a WaitingApproval meeting with no assigned approver.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG79".
Both meetings are Draft again.
pre: thuky owns both meetings (legacy data).

cases.d: Verify Publish returns MSG46 when the organizer no longer has MeetingCreator.
exp: HTTP 403 Forbidden response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG46", message "Cuộc họp này không còn có thể công bố.".
The meeting stays Approved.
pre: thuky owns an Approved meeting with a Chair and a Secretary.
MeetingCreator was removed from thuky's role.

cases.d: Verify Publish returns MSG137 when the meeting lacks a Chair or a Secretary.
exp: HTTP 409 Conflict response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG137", message "Cuộc họp cần có đúng một Chủ tọa đang hoạt động và ít nhất một Thư ký đang hoạt động trước khi công bố.".
The meeting stays Approved.
pre: thuky owns an Approved meeting with no active Secretary on the roster.

cases.d: Verify Publish succeeds without a separate meeting session and returns MSG45.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response with code "MSG45".
status is Published and the history has a Publish entry.
Invitations are queued for the roster.
pre: thuky owns an Approved meeting with an active Chair and Secretary.

cases.d: Verify Cancel returns MSG261 and the meeting with its cancellation.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG261" ("Đã huỷ cuộc họp."), meeting.status "Cancelled".
meeting.cancellation.reason is "Đổi kế hoạch" with who cancelled and when.
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify Cancel without a reason returns MSG262.
steps: Send { "action": "Cancel" } to /api/meetings/<id>/transitions as thuky.
Send { "action": "Cancel", "reason": "  " }.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG262" ("Cần nhập lý do huỷ cuộc họp.").
The meeting stays Draft.
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify a cancellation reason over 1000 characters returns MSG345.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG345" ("Lý do huỷ không được vượt quá 1.000 ký tự.").
pre: thuky owns a Draft.

cases.d: Verify a meeting that has started cannot be cancelled (409 MSG263).
exp: HTTP 409 Conflict response with code "MSG263" ("Cuộc họp này không còn có thể huỷ.").
The meeting stays InProgress.
pre: thuky owns a meeting that is InProgress.

cases.d: Verify someone who is not the organizer cannot cancel (403 MSG263).
exp: HTTP 403 Forbidden response with code "MSG263".
The meeting stays WaitingApproval.
pre: chutoa is the assigned approver (and has MeetingCreator) of a meeting owned by thuky.

cases.d: Verify a cancellation that cannot be saved returns MSG264.
exp: HTTP 503 Service Unavailable response with code "MSG264" ("Không thể huỷ cuộc họp. Vui lòng thử lại.").
pre: thuky owns a Draft.
The PostgreSQL container is stopped just before the request.

cases.d: Verify an administrator can transfer a deactivated organizer's meeting (MSG89) with typed history.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
Response JSON body: code "MSG89" ("Đã chuyển cuộc họp cho người tổ chức mới."), meetingId, status "Approved".
The history records the previous and new organizer; the approver is unchanged.
The new organizer is notified.
pre: The organizer of an Approved meeting has been deactivated.
The replacement is active and has MeetingCreator.
Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local (AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify a recovery administrator receives no sensitive meeting content.
steps: As quantri, send GET /api/meetings/<id> and GET /api/meetings/<id>/history.
As quantri, send the TransferOrganizer transition for the meeting.
exp: Both GET requests return HTTP 404 Not Found.
The transfer returns HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG89" but no title, description or location.
pre: A Secret meeting titled "Restricted title for recovery" belongs to a deactivated organizer.
quantri is not related to the meeting.

cases.d: Verify the transfer rechecks AdminUsers even with an old access token.

req.as: Authorization: Bearer <administrator token issued before the role lost AdminUsers>

exp: HTTP 404 Not Found response.
The organizer is not changed; no history or notification is written.
pre: The administrator's role lost AdminUsers after the token was issued.

cases.d: Verify the transfer body is strict and other actions do not accept organizerId.
steps: As quantri, send each body to /api/meetings/<id>/transitions: { "action": "TransferOrganizer" }; with "organizerId": null; with "organizerId": 23; with the all-zero UUID; with an extra "reason": null; with an extra "assignedApproverId"; with organizerId given twice; and { "action": "Publish", "organizerId": "<id>" }.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 400 Bad Request with code "MSG80".
No history or notification is written.
pre: A meeting of a deactivated organizer exists.
Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local (AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify an invalid replacement returns MSG134 and a failed save returns MSG88.
steps: Deactivate the replacement, then send the TransferOrganizer request as quantri.
Reactivate the replacement, stop PostgreSQL and send the request again.
exp: The first returns HTTP 400 with code "MSG134" ("Người tổ chức mới không hợp lệ hoặc không còn quyền tạo cuộc họp.").
The second returns HTTP 503 with code "MSG88".
The organizer stays the previous one.
pre: A meeting of a deactivated organizer exists.
Signed in as quantri@trustcabinet.local (AdminUsers).

cases.d: Verify the assigned Secretary can read the detail, the list entry and the rejection before publication.
steps: For a Draft, a Rejected and an Approved meeting with the Secretary on the roster, send GET /api/meetings/<id>, GET /api/meetings and GET /api/meetings/<id>/history as the Secretary.
exp: All requests return HTTP 200 OK.
The meeting appears in the Secretary's list.
The history shows the rejection reason "Lý do dành cho thư ký".
pre: An active member is on the roster as Secretary (accepted, not delegated).

cases.d: Verify an invalid Secretary assignment does not grant access to the history.
steps: As each user, send GET /api/meetings/<id of the Rejected meeting>/history: a user with only the global Secretary role; a Secretary of another meeting; a Secretary who delegated; a Secretary whose seat points to a delegate.
exp: Every request returns HTTP 404 Not Found.
pre: A Rejected meeting exists; none of these users is its active Secretary.

cases.d: Verify the current assigned approver sees the full history.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
items include the Reject entry with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu".
pre: chutoa is the current assigned approver and rejected the meeting with reason "Cần bổ sung số liệu".

cases.d: Verify a participant of a Published meeting sees a redacted timeline.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
The timeline lists the steps but hides the internal rejection reason "Lý do nội bộ".
pre: thanhvien is a participant of a Published meeting that was once rejected with reason "Lý do nội bộ".

cases.d: Verify the assigned Chair can read the meeting before publication, with organizer-only details hidden.
steps: As the Chair, send GET /api/meetings/<id> and GET /api/meetings/<id>/history.
exp: Both requests return HTTP 200 OK.
The history hides the reason meant only for the organizer and secretary and the previous organizer id.
pre: An active member is the accepted Chair of a Rejected meeting.

cases.d: Verify an approver left on a Draft from old data is not treated as the current approver.
steps: As that approver, send GET /api/meetings/<id>, GET /api/meetings/<id>/history and GET /api/meetings.
exp: Detail and history return HTTP 404 Not Found.
The meeting does not appear in the approver's list.
pre: A Draft still stores a former approver from legacy data.

cases.d: Verify a page far beyond the end returns an empty page.
exp: HTTP 200 OK response.
items is empty and totalCount is 1.
pre: thuky owns a meeting with one history entry.

cases.d: Verify a page whose offset cannot be represented returns MSG86.
exp: HTTP 400 Bad Request response with code "MSG86" ("Tham số truy vấn không hợp lệ.").
pre: thuky owns a meeting whose history count is too large for that offset (test data).

cases.d: Verify the organizer recovers a meeting from an ineligible approver and resubmits to a new one.
steps: Submit thuky's Draft to approver A.
Remove MeetingApprover from A (or deactivate A).
As thuky, send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" }.
Submit again to approver B.
exp: ReturnToDraft returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG79".
The second submit returns HTTP 200; the approver is B.
The history keeps every earlier step.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
Two approvers A and B exist.

cases.d: Verify a legacy missing or self assignment can be withdrawn and history stays unchanged.
steps: As thuky, send { "action": "ReturnToDraft" } to the legacy WaitingApproval meeting.
Submit it to a new approver.
exp: Both requests succeed.
The original SubmitForApproval history row is unchanged.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
A WaitingApproval meeting has no approver or thuky as approver (legacy data).

cases.d: Verify an administrator transfers an Approved meeting and the new organizer publishes it.
steps: Deactivate the organizer of an Approved meeting.
As quantri, transfer the meeting to the replacement.
As the replacement, publish the meeting.
exp: Transfer returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG89".
Publish returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG45".
History holds both steps and earlier rows are unchanged.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
The meeting has an active Chair and Secretary.

cases.d: Verify the history can be read while another transaction locks the meeting row.
steps: In psql, run BEGIN; SELECT id FROM meetings WHERE id = '<id>' FOR UPDATE; and keep the transaction open.
Send GET /api/meetings/<id>/history as thuky.
exp: The history request returns HTTP 200 OK without waiting for the lock.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
thuky owns the meeting.

cases.d: Verify the development demo meeting is ready and can be published without reseeding.
steps: Start the backend on a fresh development database.
As thuky, submit the demo meeting to chutoa; as chutoa, approve it; as thuky, publish it.
Restart the backend.
exp: Each step succeeds (MSG78, MSG43, MSG45).
After restart the demo stays Published and is not recreated.
pre: Fresh development database with the seeded demo accounts.

cases.d: Verify Publish commits the invitation dispatch in the same transaction.
steps: As thuky, publish an Approved meeting with a Chair and a Secretary.
Query the invitation dispatch table for the meeting.
exp: Publish returns HTTP 200 with code "MSG45".
One invitation dispatch row exists for the meeting.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.

cases.d: Verify Approve saves the status and history through the real database.
steps: As the assigned approver, send { "action": "Approve" }.
Query the meetings and meeting_status_history tables.
exp: HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG43".
The meeting is Approved and a new Approve history row exists.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
A WaitingApproval meeting "EF-backed approval" is assigned to the approver.

cases.d: Verify Publish works for a meeting without sessions on the real database.
steps: As thuky, publish an Approved meeting with a Chair and a Secretary and no session rows.
exp: HTTP 200 OK with code "MSG45"; the meeting is Published.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.

cases.d: Verify Secretary history access follows the stored assignment and keeps details private.
steps: Change the Secretary's seat to a plain member, then request the history.
Mark the Secretary as delegated, then request the history.
Point the seat to a delegate, then request the history.
exp: Each request returns HTTP 404 Not Found.
No detail of the Secret meeting is returned.
pre: Backend runs on PostgreSQL.
A Secret, Rejected meeting "Restricted meeting" has an accepted Secretary.

cases.d: Verify the meeting sessions migration only adds its table and index.
steps: Apply migrations up to MeetingSessionsForPublication on an empty database.
Inspect the schema change.
exp: Only the table meeting_sessions and its index are created.
pre: PostgreSQL test database is available.
